derivation: from a compound of G4862 (σύν) and G2239 (ἦθος);

occurrences.text: But ye have a custom, that I should release unto you one at the passover: will ye therefore that I release unto you the King of the Jews?
But if any man seem to be contentious, we have no such custom, neither the churches of God.
